benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. The full runner was not executed because ghc, cabal, and stack are not installed in this environment; upstream test-pandoc and test-pandoc-lua-engine must be built as Haskell Tasty executables and run from a full checkout, and the current cache is blob-filtered/no-checkout for modest resource use. Native PHP progress maps 49 focused Markdown/WordPress writer checks, including the Tests.Readers.Markdown nested list case, all eight definition-list cases, inline-code list-marker regression cases, two test/command/indented-fences.md fenced-code examples, block quote cases from test/testsuite.txt, the test/testsuite.txt indented code-block tab-expansion cases cross-checked against test/testsuite.native, horizontal-rule forms from the Code Blocks/Lists sections including spaced asterisks that must not become a bullet list, tight/loose list continuation paragraph shapes from the Lists section, fancy ordered-list markers with parenthesized decimals, roman numerals, alphabetic markers, and Pandoc autonumbering, the 93-line test/testsuite.txt Definition Lists section slice covering multiple-block bodies, indented code, block quotes, alternate ~ markers, and nested ordered lists, the 102-line test/testsuite.txt HTML Blocks section slice covering parsed div containers, raw table/script/comment/hr blocks, and indented HTML that remains code, plus the bounded test/testsuite.txt Inline Markup slice for underscore emphasis/strong and triple-marker strong-emphasis nesting.
